text: 中国财政部发行28天期债券，规模200亿元，发行利率0.9131%，边际利率1.0045%，预期0.9800%，投标倍数3.90倍，边际倍数2.72倍； 中国财政部发行91天期债券，规模350亿元，发行利率1.1182%，边际利率1.1585%，预期1.1800%，投标倍数3.67倍，边际倍数2.54倍。
text_en: China's Ministry of Finance issued 28-day bonds, with a scale of RMB 20 billion, an issuance rate of 0.9131%, a marginal rate of 1.0045%, an expectation of 0.9800%, a bid-to-cover ratio of 3.90 times, and a marginal ratio of 2.72 times; China's Ministry of Finance issued 91-day bonds, with a scale of RMB 35 billion, an issuance rate of 1.1182%, a marginal rate of 1.1585%, an expectation of 1.1800%, a bid-to-cover ratio of 3.67 times, and a marginal ratio of 2.54 times.
